anti_goals: Do not change TimerCapability.kt, TimerAlertPolicy.kt or PlatformRuntimeAdapter.kt; Timer & Alert and Android Runtime Adapter remain read-only/regression owners.
Do not repair overdue audio, audio policy, audible behavior, ramp/repeat/cap, permissions or any FT-007 outcome; W23 remains historical context only.

Do not change idle Main Display geometry, weather projection/content/freshness/palette/day-night/pressure, Settings, provider/network behavior or card ownership except hiding those elements on the dedicated active-countdown surface.

Do not add a lifecycle state, change timer arithmetic/persistence/one-active-timer semantics, alter selected-preset or gesture contracts, add reboot recovery, a new module/edge/public contract/dependency/event path or composition-root orchestration.
Do not choose fixed dp values, font ratios, product ratios or neon gradient stops; route any material numeric product decision to /feature-doctor FT-006.

constraints: Main Display owns the user-facing composition and may add the bounded active-countdown surface only inside DisplayCapability.kt; it consumes Timer & Alert projections and does not calculate remaining time or write timer state.

The active countdown surface must contain no weather card, city, date or standard card-shell content; the countdown digits must be materially larger than the final idle-clock result in the same host comparison, without a new fixed numeric target.

The transparent neon circular backdrop uses the activating preset's existing PresetPresentation color identity; selected preset and active styling remain consistent with the existing projection and touch route.

Existing single-tap hint, double-tap cancellation, temporary interruption rehydration, one-active-timer invariant and network independence remain unchanged and are regression-checked through existing capability contracts.
Host visual/lifecycle proof is claim-linked and isolated; target readability/lifecycle/audio runtime is DEFERRED and never inferred from host evidence.
